name: collab-stack-yjs14-rc-compat
description: Spike 5, brief 02, task 6: Yjs 13 / Yjs 14 update-bytes compatibility probe. Separate subpackage (own node_modules, no npm overrides) so real yjs@13.6.33 + y-prosemirror@1.3.7 can coexist with @y/y + @y/prosemirror without the parent package's yjs->@y/y alias getting in the way.
